interpretation: None of the six tested setup families had positive net expectancy across discovery, calibration, chronological test and unseen-symbol holdout under the fixed barrier contracts.

The least-bad chronological test result was FIRST_BREAK with the 2.2%/1.4% contract, but it remained negative after estimated costs and failed badly in discovery and symbol holdout. It must not be promoted.
This run is negative evidence against using broad indicator combinations or a raw score as proof of edge.

methodologyDefectsFound.name: CURRENT_UNIVERSE_SURVIVORSHIP
methodologyDefectsFound.detail: The v1 symbol universe was selected from currently trading/currently liquid Binance pairs. Delisted and historically liquid pairs were therefore absent.
methodologyDefectsFound.requiredFix: Build the research universe from Binance Vision archive listings and apply liquidity eligibility point-in-time at each event.

methodologyDefectsFound.name: FILTERED_BARRIER_TIMELINE
methodologyDefectsFound.detail: Barrier traversal used the post-feature/post-liquidity filtered symbol frame. A liquidity-filter gap could make the next retained row differ from the true next market bar.
methodologyDefectsFound.requiredFix: Generate signals on the feature frame but label entries/exits against the untouched raw OHLC timeline.

methodologyDefectsFound.name: STABLE_SYMBOL_EXCLUSION_DRIFT
methodologyDefectsFound.detail: UUSDT appeared in the archive sample although the live runtime excludes U as a stable-like base.
methodologyDefectsFound.requiredFix: Use one canonical stable/base exclusion policy across live and research.

nextAction: STOP parameter tuning on v1. Build archive-derived, regime-stratified v2 with raw-timeline labels, point-in-time liquidity, multiple-testing control, cost stress and untouched symbol/time holdouts before changing any live entry rule.
